asset_observations.visual: Customer-specific Elastic identity diagram: blue trust boundary contains employee, enterprise applications, non-MFA service accounts, Okta session and fine-grained PAT; purple partial boundary contains classic PAT and public repository. SSH keys, third-party applications and anonymous public access appear outside or cross boundaries. GitHub authentication and Actions bot remain distinct from the customer's GitHub area.
statements: This illustration separates fine-grained and classic tokens into different trust zones; its placement is a customer-specific model, not a universal token-security guarantee.
Service accounts without MFA, SSH credentials, third-party integrations, federated sessions and anonymous public access introduce separate identity or boundary considerations.
GitHub authentication and an Actions bot are represented separately; their presence does not establish equivalent privileges or local enforcement.
asset_observations.rights: Elastic, Okta and GitHub names/logos and customer-specific identity context require asset-specific provenance and trademark review; root repository licensing alone does not settle these.

asset_observations.visual: Six-step larger-runner architecture: workflow triggers Actions service; runner service creates VM; Azure control plane deploys NIC inside customer Azure network guarded by NSG; NIC picks up job and sends logs using public network; runner reaches on-premises web/database resources over private ExpressRoute.
statements: Virtual-network integration places a runner NIC in the customer's Azure network but retains public Actions job pickup and log traffic.
The diagram distinguishes Azure control-plane provisioning from public job communication and private resource access.
Private on-premises resource connectivity is illustrated through ExpressRoute with a network security group; these are contextual prerequisites, not proof of configured isolation.
asset_observations.rights: GitHub/Azure architecture imagery and service marks require asset-specific provenance; no redistribution or trademark clearance is asserted.
